nodes.description: Internal view helper that uses extcodesize to determine whether an address is a deployed contract.
Payable fallback that forwards all calls to _fallback() and thus to the delegated implementation.
Payable receive that forwards plain value transfers to _fallback().
Abstract internal view returning the implementation address used by _delegate; overridden by UpgradeabilityProxy.
Internal assembly routine that delegatecalls the implementation with the full calldata and bubbles the result.
Virtual hook executed before delegation; overridden by AdminUpgradeabilityProxy to block the proxy admin.
Internal entry point that runs _willFallback() and then _delegate(_implementation()).
Constant bytes32 EIP-1967 storage slot holding the current implementation address.
Payable constructor that validates the slot constant, sets the implementation and optionally delegatecalls initialization data into it.
Overrides Proxy._implementation to sload the implementation address from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Internal function that writes a new implementation to storage and emits the Upgraded event.
Internal function that requires the new implementation to be a contract and then sstores it into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Constant bytes32 EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy admin address.
Payable constructor that chains to UpgradeabilityProxy and stores the initial admin via _setAdmin.
Admin-only external view returning the proxy admin address.
Admin-only external view returning the current implementation address.
Admin-only external function transferring proxy administration after a zero-address check.
Admin-only external function upgrading the implementation address.
Admin-only external function upgrading the implementation and then delegatecalling arbitrary calldata into it.
Internal view that sloads the admin address from ADMIN_SLOT.
Internal function that sstores the new admin address into ADMIN_SLOT.
Override that reverts when the fallback caller equals the proxy admin, then calls super._willFallback().
Caller-controlled address used for admin authorization checks in the ifAdmin modifier and _willFallback.
Raw assembly delegatecall forwarding full calldata and gas to the implementation address read from storage.
Constructor-time delegatecall executing caller-supplied initialization data inside the _logic contract.
Assembly sstore writing the implementation address directly into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Admin-triggered delegatecall executing arbitrary calldata on the newly set implementation address.
Assembly sstore writing the admin address directly into ADMIN_SLOT.
Address argument whose code size is inspected by extcodesize.
Local uint256 receiving the extcodesize result before the >0 comparison.
Implementation address passed into _delegate as the delegatecall target.
Assembly local holding the delegatecall success flag used by the switch.
Initial implementation address supplied at deployment.
Optional initialization calldata delegatecalled into the logic contract.
Local bool capturing the delegatecall result of the initialization call.
Initial admin address supplied at deployment and written to ADMIN_SLOT.
New implementation address validated with Address.isContract and sstored.
Replacement admin address checked against address(0) before _setAdmin.
Implementation address forwarded to _upgradeTo.
Implementation address forwarded to _upgradeTo before the delegatecall.
Arbitrary calldata delegatecalled into the new implementation.
Local bool capturing the delegatecall result, enforced with require(success).
Admin address written into ADMIN_SLOT.
Local copy of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT used by the sload assembly.
Local copy of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT used by the sstore assembly.
Local copy of ADMIN_SLOT used by the sload assembly.
Local copy of ADMIN_SLOT used by the sstore assembly.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against the stored admin in the _willFallback require, deterministic access-control dependency.
ifAdmin modifier gates admin() on msg.sender equalling _admin().
ifAdmin modifier gates implementation() on msg.sender equalling _admin().
ifAdmin modifier gates changeAdmin() on msg.sender equalling _admin().
ifAdmin modifier gates upgradeTo() on msg.sender equalling _admin().
ifAdmin modifier gates upgradeToAndCall() on msg.sender equalling _admin().
fallback() unconditionally calls _fallback().
receive() unconditionally calls _fallback().
_fallback() runs the _willFallback() hook first.
_fallback() resolves the target through _implementation().
_fallback() hands control to _delegate().
_delegate performs a raw delegatecall with caller calldata, transferring control to the implementation which can re-enter the proxy.
The implementation parameter is the delegatecall target inside _delegate.
The implementation parameter is consumed directly by the assembly delegatecall.
The constructor delegatecalls _data into _logic, an external call executed during deployment.
_logic is the implementation address set by the constructor.
_data length is checked and, if non-empty, used for the initialization call.
_data is the exact payload of the constructor delegatecall.
The constructor calls _setImplementation(_logic).
The constructor asserts against the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant.
_upgradeTo calls _setImplementation before emitting the event.
_setImplementation performs the sstore into the implementation slot.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is the storage location written by _setImplementation.
_implementation sloads the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant.
The AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor chains to the UpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
The constructor stores the initial admin via _setAdmin.
The constructor asserts against the ADMIN_SLOT constant.
The _admin constructor parameter is stored as the proxy admin.
changeAdmin calls _setAdmin(newAdmin).
newAdmin flows from the changeAdmin argument to the zero-address check and _setAdmin.
The newAdmin parameter is the value sstored by _setAdmin.
_setAdmin performs the sstore into the admin slot.
ADMIN_SLOT is the storage location written by _setAdmin.
_admin sloads the ADMIN_SLOT constant.
upgradeTo calls _upgradeTo(newImplementation).
upgradeToAndCall calls _upgradeTo before the delegatecall.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls arbitrary caller-supplied data into the new implementation, enabling reentrancy.
newImplementation flows into _upgradeTo from upgradeToAndCall.
The data calldata is used as the delegatecall payload in upgradeToAndCall.
The data calldata is consumed directly by the delegatecall operation.
newImplementation flows into _upgradeTo from upgradeTo.
newImplementation is validated and then written to the implementation slot.
admin() returns _admin().
implementation() returns _implementation().
changeAdmin reads the previous admin through _admin() for the event.
_willFallback override calls super._willFallback().
The account parameter is passed to extcodesize inside isContract.
extcodesize of account is assigned to the size local variable.
_setImplementation calls Address.isContract(newImplementation) as a guard.
The assembly result local holds the delegatecall return flag used by the switch.
The success local captures the constructor delegatecall result used by require.
The success local captures the upgradeToAndCall delegatecall result used by require.
The slot local feeds the sload inside _implementation.
The slot local feeds the sstore inside _setImplementation.
The slot local feeds the sload inside _admin.
The slot local feeds the sstore inside _setAdmin.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter only exists to be measured by extcodesize inside isContract, so it collapses into that function node.
The size local is a pure intermediate for the extcodesize return value of isContract.
The implementation parameter is only used as the delegatecall target inside _delegate.
result is the raw outcome flag of the assembly delegatecall and belongs to that unsafe operation.
_logic is the deployment argument stored by the constructor and has no other container.
_data is the constructor initialization payload consumed within the same function.
success is the return flag of the constructor delegatecall and normalizes into that unsafe operation.
_admin is stored by the constructor through _setAdmin and has no standalone identity.
The parameter is checked and written to storage entirely within _setImplementation.
newAdmin is validated and forwarded to _setAdmin only inside changeAdmin.
The parameter is simply forwarded to _upgradeTo by upgradeTo.
The parameter is only forwarded to _upgradeTo inside upgradeToAndCall.
data is the exact payload of the delegatecall and normalizes into that unsafe operation.
success is the require-checked return flag of the delegatecall in upgradeToAndCall.
newAdmin is the value written to ADMIN_SLOT and belongs to the sstore operation.
The slot local is an alias of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT used only inside _implementation.
The slot local is the storage key of the sstore and merges into that unsafe operation.
The slot local is an alias of ADMIN_SLOT used only inside _admin.
The slot local is the storage key of the admin sstore and merges into that unsafe operation.
